comment: Read from src/Automata at commit 37a37b0, the commit whose plugin.json carries the installed 2.2.3, alongside the plugin's wiki page for Automata, which matches the code. The eight trigger outputs are given no family because what each carries depends on its own menu setting: a trigger in one mode and a slowly moving percentage voltage in the other. The LEN CV jack is scaled by the full sequence length of 64 before the attenuverter (Automata.cpp:170 to 172), so it moves the length much further per volt than the RND % jack moves the density. The board, the rule editor and the trigger marks all live in display widgets rather than parameters, so none of them can be clicked for a help line.
